Temple of Heaven {天坛} in the morning → Olympic Park {奥林匹克公园} → Sanlitun {三里屯} → back to hotel

Liziba {李子坝} (train through the building) → Eling Park {鹅岭公园} & Eling Second Factory {鹅岭二厂} → Ciqikou {磁器口} → evening: Yangtze River Cableway {长江索道} and night cruise from Chaotianmen {朝天门} → back to hotel
Day trip: Wulong Karst {武隆} — Three Natural Bridges {天生三桥} → back to Chongqing

zjj.summary: Arrive → transfer to Wulingyuan {武陵源} → check in and rest → evening on Xibu Street {溪布街} → back to hotel

Forest Park at opening → Bailong Elevator {百龙天梯} up → Yuanjiajie {袁家界} (the “Avatar” peaks: Mihuntai {迷魂台}, Hallelujah Mountain {乾坤柱}, First Bridge Under Heaven {天下第一桥}) → park shuttle bus to Tianzi Mountain {天子山} → Tianzi cable car down → back to hotel
Check out → taxi to Zhangjiajie city {张家界市区} → Tianmen Mountain {天门山}: cable car, Tianmen Cave, cliff walkways → night in the city near Zhangjiajie West station {张家界西}
